title: Unions take legal action against Microsoft for allegedly mishandling Xbox layoffs
description: CWA Canada president Carmel Smyth claims the company 'unlawfully fired people without giving notice to or discussing it with the union.'

title: 'The goal of design is to efficiently communicate ideas'
description: Revisiting Stone Librande's classic One Page Designs GDC talk, for a dose of the good stuff.

title: ZeniMax Online Studios leadership included in Xbox mass layoffs
description: The studio head, studio operations director, and studio game director join dozens of senior and lead positions cut by Xbox.

title: Pokemon Go owner Scopely 'reorganizes' Stumble Guys team
description: The reorganization has affected a 'small number of employees.'

title: Former Epic Games VP appointed Saber Interactive's chief business officer
description: Steve Allison will oversee publishing, marketing, and revenue opportunities, reporting directly to CEO Matthew Karch.

title: Dead Space co-creator Glen Schofield retires
description: Schofield had long tenures as manager of Dead Space maker Visceral Games as well as Call of Duty developer Sledgehammer Games.

title: NYU opens incubator applications for New York City-area devs
description: The NYC Game Design Future Lab offers mentorship, workshop, and investor opportunities for Big Apple-based developers.

title: UK union launches free resource to decode video game writing contracts
description: The Writers' Guild of Great Britain said it has witnessed an increase in poor practices around writing contracts in recent years.

title: IWGB Game Workers union forms 'redundancy taskforce' to defend workers' rights
description: 'With training, solidarity and support, workers can stand up to bosses who use redundancy to cover for their own mismanagement and greed.'

title: 'The entire thing is going to fall apart:' Inside the latest round of mass layoffs at Xbox
description: Multiple workers impacted by the latest job cuts at Xbox believe the decision will hamstring some studios.

title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced crosses 2 million in sales as studio strikes over proposed layoffs
description: Ubisoft sold over 2 million copies of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced in 24 hours, all while its Barcelona studio striking over the proposed layoffs of 51 employees.

title: Paramount confirms Mike Zaimont is employed by Avatar Legends dev
description: Zaimont 'holds a position as an individual developer' at Gameplay Group International. He was previously accused of sexual harassment during his time as CEO of Lab Zero Games.

title: Compulsion Games posts call for business partners after Xbox spinoff
description: 'We invite partners to leverage the talent and creativity of the award-winning team behind South of Midnight.'

title: Studio founded by former Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes GM lays off staff
description: Azra Games is 'reducing the size of its team' two years after raising $42 million in funding—and before it's even launched its debut game UnGodly.

title: Spin Master lays off Paw Patrol: The Game devs two days after launch
description: Spin Master says Toronto-based Sago Mini Team will take over Originator Inc's development duties.

description: Word Play is now available on iPhone and iPad. Get the free trial here

title: The GMTK Game Jam 2026 Theme is...
100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The GMTK Game Jam returns for 2026
The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
